content.text:
I submitted **index 22 (Pb 0.34 / Sb 0.66)** as the best composition. It had an EQE of 0.058% at 3.2 eV illumination.

The budget allowed only three merit measurements, and all three are used:

| Index | Pb / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.68 / 0.32 | 0.014 |
| 14 | 0.50 / 0.50 (the Pb₂Sb₂O₇ composition) | 0.022 |
| 22 | 0.34 / 0.66 (close to the PbSb₂O₆ composition) | 0.058 |

EQE rose steadily as the Sb fraction increased. The most Sb-rich samples (indices 23–29, up to Sb 0.71) were never measured, so the peak could lie there and index 22 may not be the true best.

I used none of the five XRD measurements, so I haven't checked which crystal phase is present at any of these compositions.
